analysis.themes: Two neighbors whose spouses are having an affair circle each other without ever acting — desire expressed entirely through restraint.
analysis.atmosphere: Exquisite longing; rain, lamplight, and the same waltz make repetition feel like aching.
analysis.narrative: Elliptical and repetitive by design — noodles bought, corridors crossed, a rehearsal of confessions never meant to be real.
analysis.visual: Christopher Doyle's saturated, frame-within-frame photography traps the lovers visually the way propriety traps them emotionally.
analysis.characters: Chow and Su exist mostly in glances and silences; the absent spouses we never see shape everything they refuse to do.
